items.brief: OCC publishes final GENIUS Act stablecoin rule, effective Jan. 18
items.why: First final stablecoin rule under the GENIUS Act, dropping a proposed presumption on third-party rewards.

items.brief: OCC final rule to weigh stablecoin rewards against GENIUS Act ban
items.why: Clarifies how stablecoin reward programs fit under the new federal framework.

items.brief: MoonPay, Upbit parent Dunamu explore stablecoin payments collaboration
items.why: Signals stablecoin payment and chain expansion efforts in Asian markets.

items.brief: OKX-ICE co-chair Andrew Cuomo calls corporate objections a 'natural response' to tokenized stock plans
items.why: Signals pushback from companies on tokenized equities via the OKX-ICE venture.

items.brief: Alphabet, Microsoft object to OKX-ICE proposed tokenized stock platform
items.why: Companies are seeking to opt out of a tokenized stock platform tied to US-listed equities.

items.brief: Injective partners with BDACS to bring Korean won stablecoin to RWA ecosystem
items.why: Adds a fiat stablecoin to tokenized real-world asset settlement.

items.brief: Stablecoins move over $400M per hour as off-hours transfers dominate
items.why: Shows stablecoin rails carrying growing tokenized transfer volume.

items.brief: Microsoft, Alphabet, Goldman Sachs object to OKX-ICE tokenized stock trading plan
items.why: Adds to issuer objections that could shape which stocks appear on tokenized stock venues.

items.brief: France's parliament approves 31% capital gains tax on stablecoin trades
items.why: Tax treatment shapes stablecoin use as settlement for tokenized assets.

items.brief: Blockchain Association seeks clearer DeFi, foreign issuer rules in GENIUS rollout
items.why: Comments target who may issue and sell tokenized payment stablecoins.
